the value of the hepatobiliary phase for the diagnosis of scirrhosis is not clear.

gadobenate dimegumine-enhanced MR imaging is useful for the differential diagnosis of scirrhos HCC and CC.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of peripheral hyperintensity on T2-weighting and target appearance on hepatobiliary-phase gadobenate dimegumine-enhanced MR images are useful to differentiate scirhous HCC from HCC.
